output.summary: The incident rise is mainly a self-reinforcing reliability-debt loop. The Meridian pause and later load deferred fixes, and 60% of Q3 SEV1-SEV2 incidents recurred a known, overdue failure mode. Storage's exemption cut its incidents and pages while its traffic share stayed flat. Volume grew only 7%, and the tool migration affects SEV4 only. Networking's second-slot pilot did not improve acknowledgment or incidents and worsened on-call load, so A1 is harmful. The hiring freeze came after the rise began. Attrition shows both pay and on-call as reasons, and they cannot be separated. Ring-fencing engineers to close overdue action items is preferred. A5 repeats the 2023 under-declaration problem. A4 is premature until stay interviews are done.
